title: Reservation Status Reference — Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Reservation status reference

Every reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category carries one status at a time.

| Status | How a stay reaches it |
|---|---|
| requested | the stay is booked; a request-to-book stay waits for the host |
| confirmed | the host accepts the booking request, or an Instant Book request is accepted automatically at the moment it is booked |
| declined | the host declines the booking request; no money is collected |
| expired | the booking request lapses because the host did not accept it in time; no money is collected |
| checked in | the check-in date arrives on a confirmed stay and the stay is in progress |
| completed | the check-out date arrives on a stay in progress |
| cancelled by guest | the guest cancels a confirmed stay before check-in, or a stay in progress and leaves early, or the stay is cancelled for non-payment of a scheduled installment, which is treated as a guest cancellation |
| cancelled by host | the host cancels the confirmed stay before check-in |

## Rules of progression

1. A request-to-book stay waits for the host. A booking request expires when the host has not accepted it within the policy's request-expiry period in elapsed hours after the reservation was booked; the hours are counted in elapsed clock time from the booking time, and acceptance at any moment up to the boundary confirms the stay.
2. A declined or expired request collects nothing and leaves nothing to refund.
3. A listing may confirm stays by Instant Book only when the stay's policy permits Instant Book.
4. A confirmed stay becomes checked in on its check-in date and completed on its check-out date without any action; a stay that was cancelled never checks in.
5. Check-in releases the host's earnings and assesses the host service fee under the Payout Methods and Host Accounts rules.

## Expiry cases (hypothetical times, 24-hour request-expiry period)

| Booked | Host accepts | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-10 09:00 | 2026-05-11 08:59 | confirmed |
| 2026-05-10 09:00 | 2026-05-11 09:00 (exactly 24 hours) | confirmed |
| 2026-05-10 09:00 | not accepted by 2026-05-11 09:00 | expires; nothing collected or refunded |
